name: Impossible Charm
text: Type the following line into ChatGPT and put the response on the stack: "Give me exactly one option for three abilities for my Magic the Gathering 3 mana charm. Nothing else."
prompt: Give me exactly one option for three abilities for my Magic the Gathering 3 mana charm. Nothing else.

name: The Eludha Prime
text:
Companion — Your sideboard has three or more cards with Companion.
As long as The Eludha Prime is your commander or your Companion, you may have any number of Companions, ignoring their restrictions.
You may cast spells from your Companion zone.
{2/W}{2/U}{2/B}{2/R}{2/G}: Put target creature you control or target creature card from your graveyard into your Companion zone.

name: Unnatural Selection
text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, exile a creature you control.
You may reveal an artifact or creature card you own from outside the game and put it onto the battlefield. It loses all colors and becomes an Eldrazi creature with base power and toughness 1/21 in addition to its other types.
After the game ends, remove the chosen card from your pool. (You don't own the card, you can't play it in your deck and it's no longer a part of your sideboard.)
